result: STOP: the existing larger bilingual model is not admitted for automatic second-pass transcript replacement.
scope: One frozen public-audio discovery trial, not a new Q9 acceptance set. Same real CLI diagnose/edit-note/append chain, original documents, published hotwords and canonical PCM; Legacy mode, one thread, original decoder settings. Actual owned worker model directory was independently observed.

observations.note: The complete name was recovered acoustically, separately from canonical spelling correction.

observations.bilingual_observation: The finished-eleventh clause is absent, not a different spelling of the ordinal. Sixteenth remains in both outputs.
observations.stop: Loss of a protected correct number present in the paired small-model arm; affects both raw and corrected transcript.

resource_limits: Four invocations per model only; stopped discovery sample, uncontrolled OS caches. CPU is sampled lower-bound process-tree CPU, RSS is summed tree peak and can double-count shared memory. Not whole-meeting speed, energy, streaming latency or representative accuracy.
decision: Do not implement an automatic second-pass adapter or enable the larger model by default from this trial. Do not remove the numeric stop or rerun changed hints/decoder parameters.

Retain the first name gain and the later numerical loss together; aggregate WER improvement cannot justify dropping the protected fact. The remaining 34 calls, including the 051 numeric sentinel, were not executed.
Q9 full 100-case name recall and its existing 051 regression remain open. Q16 mixed-language minutes remains open. No model/runtime download or installer build occurred.
